description: The plot illustrates the relationship between PPL and an unspecified variable on the x-axis for different values of γ. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 2K to 64K, with a logarithmic scale, and tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis is labeled "PPL" and has a linear scale, with values ranging from 7.7 to 8.2, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are shown in the plot: a blue line representing γ=0.25, an orange line representing γ=0.5, and a green line representing γ=0.75. The blue line starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K, decreases to around 7.85 at 4K, increases slightly to about 7.9 at 8K, then decreases to approximately 7.8 at 16K, before rising to around 7.82 at 32K and finally dropping to about 7.8 at 64K. The orange line begins at 8.2 at 2K, drops to about 7.85 at 4K, and continues to decrease to approximately 7.73 at 8K, 7.72 at 16K, 7.71 at 32K, and 7.71 at 64K. The green line follows a similar trend, starting at 8.2 at 2K, decreasing to around 7.85 at 4K, and further dropping to approximately 7.72 at 8K, 7.71 at 16K, 7.7 at 32K, and remaining steady at 7.7 at 64K.
